steps._comment: == DAY, the ship-neutral contract. Identity grade AND no biome-default emitter: every sky-bearing biome's default is gated to dusk/night precisely so this frame stays byte-identical to the pre-wave one. ==

DAY IS IDENTITY, asserted rather than eyeballed (v0.17 fix wave, finding #2/#9). `emitters` counts the emitters BUILT and would read 1 here whatever the gate did; `emitting` counts the ones actually moving, so this is the tooth that bites if a sky-bearing map ever starts drifting particles through a noon frame.
Row 1 of the boulevard is blocked end to end, so the bump sets facing without moving and the stationer door opens on interact.
